description: Telemetry sink admin (D22): after a MintQuery session, report and delete the SSM agent's on-disk session copy (ipcTempFile.log under /var/lib/amazon/ssm/<instance>/session/orchestration/<sessionId>/). Root on the box can read that file until it is deleted; SessionLogsDestination=none (FOUNDER-STEPS step 4) stops it being written at all. Also prints the agent's SessionLogsDestination setting.

sessionId.description: The MintQuery session id (printed by start-session)

runCommand: if [ -f "$CFG" ] && grep -q '"SessionLogsDestination"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"none"' "$CFG"; then echo 'SessionLogsDestination=none'; else echo 'WARNING: SessionLogsDestination is not none: the agent writes ipcTempFile.log for every session'; fi
for d in /var/lib/amazon/ssm/*/session/orchestration/'{{sessionId}}'; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; FOUND=1; find "$d" -name ipcTempFile.log -exec echo removing {} \;; rm -rf -- "$d"; done
